grandline.toki.no_chain: You cannot leap through time twice in a row in a fight — use another technique first.
grandline.hobi.toy: You have become a toy... and everyone has forgotten you.
grandline.horo.despair: I'm sorry I was ever born... (you cannot fight)
grandline.soru.resisted: You refuse to fear — your soul holds.
grandline.orochi.head_lost: A head is lost — but the serpent lives on!
fruit.grandline.yuki.desc: Snow-Snow Fruit (Logia): become snow. Snow blades and shuriken, blizzards that bury the ground, a snow dome that smothers ranged attacks and a whiteout to vanish into. Heat melts it: fire hurts more and a burning body cannot scatter.
fruit.grandline.gasu.desc: Gas-Gas Fruit (Logia): become and control gas. Burning gas jets, explosions at a snap, oxygen pulled out of the air and the poison cloud Shinokuni. Immune to poison.
fruit.grandline.numa.desc: Swamp-Swamp Fruit (Logia): a bottomless swamp body that swallows bullets, arrows and thrown techniques that come near, drags enemies under, holds people inside and spits everything back out. Swamp beats sand.
fruit.grandline.mori.desc: Forest-Forest Fruit (Logia): become a forest. Roots that impale and drain life, forests grown in an instant and volleys of wooden stakes. Regenerates in forests; fire is its weakness.
fruit.grandline.bomu.desc: Bomb-Bomb Fruit: any part of your body (even your breath) can explode, and no explosion can hurt you.
fruit.grandline.supa.desc: Dice-Dice Fruit: turn any part of your body into blades. A body hard as steel — cuts and stabs barely scratch it.
fruit.grandline.nikyu.desc: Paw-Paw Fruit: paw pads that repel anything — air as paw-shaped shockwaves, people sent flying over the horizon, your own body for instant travel, even pain pulled out as a bubble. Shots from the front bounce off the pads.
fruit.grandline.mochi.desc: Mochi-Mochi Fruit (Special Paramecia): shape your body into mochi — fists, the trident Mogura, spinning donuts and sticky traps. With Observation Haki up, attacks pass through you like a Logia.
fruit.grandline.horo.desc: Hollow-Hollow Fruit: create ghosts. Negative Hollows drown their victims in despair, Mini Hollows explode, and your spirit can leave your body as an untouchable ghost.
fruit.grandline.doru.desc: Wax-Wax Fruit: wax as hard as steel — shackles, walls, armour, harpoons and the Candle Service Set that turns enemies into statues. Fire melts it.
fruit.grandline.soru.desc: Soul-Soul Fruit: take years of lifespan from those who fear you and give souls to objects — the thundercloud Zeus, the sun Prometheus, the sword Napoleon, and the land itself.
fruit.grandline.hobi.desc: Hobby-Hobby Fruit: a touch turns people into toys. Toys shrink, cannot fight, are forgotten by everyone — and must obey you.
fruit.grandline.toki.desc: Time-Time Fruit: travel forward in time and send others into the future. In a fight you cannot leap twice in a row. Harmful effects wear off twice as fast.
fruit.grandline.zou_elephant.desc: Elephant-Elephant Fruit (Zoan): a huge elephant body — a trunk that whips, hurls and sprays water strong enough to reach a Logia, tusks that gore and stomps that shake the ground.
fruit.grandline.ryu_allosaurus.desc: Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Model: Allosaurus (Ancient Zoan): crushing jaws, a heavy tail and a body built to take punishment. Bites heal you.
fruit.grandline.ryu_pteranodon.desc: Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Model: Pteranodon (Ancient Zoan): great wings to soar and glide, diving talons and wing blades. No fall damage while transformed.
fruit.grandline.ryu_spinosaurus.desc: Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Model: Spinosaurus (Ancient Zoan): long jaws, a bladed sail and a crushing tail. Heals faster in the sun; awakened, it falls into a primal frenzy.
fruit.grandline.uo_seiryu.desc: Fish-Fish Fruit, Model: Azure Dragon (Mythical Zoan): fly on the clouds, breathe concentrated heat, cut with blades of wind and raise tornadoes. Dragon scales shrug off blades and fire.
fruit.grandline.hebi_orochi.desc: Snake-Snake Fruit, Model: Yamata no Orochi (Mythical Zoan): eight heads that bite at once, venom and crushing coils — and losing a head does not kill you.
ability.grandline.fruit.yuki.tabira_yuki: A long blade of packed snow sweeps everything in front, slowing and freezing.
A fan of five snowflake shuriken that chill whoever they hit.
ability.grandline.fruit.yuki.yuki_gaki.d: A blizzard over the target area buries the ground in snow and freezes and blinds everyone inside.
ability.grandline.fruit.yuki.kamakura.de: A dome of packed snow: ranged attacks deal 60% less and anyone striking you up close is frozen.
A whiteout swallows the area: you vanish into it while everything inside slows, freezes and is finally encased.
ability.grandline.fruit.gasu.gastille.de: A burner jet of ignited gas that scorches everything in a line.
ability.grandline.fruit.gasu.gastanet.de: Gas between the palms, ignited: a point-blank explosion that sets enemies alight.
ability.grandline.fruit.gasu.oxygen_drai: Pull the oxygen out of an area: everyone inside chokes (growing damage through guard), reels and weakens.
ability.grandline.fruit.gasu.gas_robe.de: Your body burns as a robe of flame: nearby enemies are scorched every second and attackers catch fire.
ability.grandline.fruit.gasu.shinokuni.d: A giant creeping cloud of poison gas drifts over the battlefield, then petrifies whoever breathed it.
A hand of mud rises under the target and drags it down.
ability.grandline.fruit.numa.swamp_field: The ground at the target point turns to swamp; anyone on it sinks and struggles.
ability.grandline.fruit.numa.swamp_swall: Swallow a target whole: it is held inside your swamp body, suffocating, then spat out.
Spit out a volley of mud — one extra, harder shot for every projectile your body has swallowed.
ability.grandline.fruit.numa.bottomless_: The whole area becomes a sucking swamp that swallows enemies and projectiles, then erupts in a mud geyser.
Roots burst out of the ground under the target and impale it.
ability.grandline.fruit.mori.nutrient_dr: Roots latch on and drain the target's life through its guard, healing you.
A forest bursts out of the ground: trunks wall the area and roots entangle everyone inside.
ability.grandline.fruit.mori.thorn_volle: A rapid barrage of sharpened wooden stakes.
ability.grandline.fruit.mori.great_fores: Your body spreads as a forest over the area; roots everywhere impale and drain every enemy at once.
ability.grandline.fruit.bomu.nose_fancy_: A flicked bomb that explodes on contact.
ability.grandline.fruit.bomu.kick_bomb.d: A kick that detonates on impact.
ability.grandline.fruit.bomu.breeze_brea: Exhaled air that explodes in a chain along its path.
ability.grandline.fruit.bomu.bomb_grab.d: Seize the enemy and detonate your whole body — guard is useless.
ability.grandline.fruit.bomu.chain_deton: Become a living bomb and explode in three ever-larger blasts.
ability.grandline.fruit.supa.sparkling_d: Your arms become great blades in a cleaving sweep that leaves enemies bleeding.
ability.grandline.fruit.supa.atomic_spar: A cross-cut so fast it flies off as a piercing crescent of steel.
ability.grandline.fruit.supa.spider.desc: Harden into polished steel: damage taken drops by 75% and melee attackers cut themselves, but you can barely move.
ability.grandline.fruit.supa.spiral_holl: Spinning blades sprout from your body as you drill straight through the enemy line.
ability.grandline.fruit.supa.blade_storm: Blades erupt from every inch of your body in all directions.
ability.grandline.fruit.nikyu.pad_ho.des: A paw-shaped bubble of compressed air that slams the target away.
ability.grandline.fruit.nikyu.tsuppari_p: A rapid barrage of paw bubbles.
ability.grandline.fruit.nikyu.paw_travel: Repel your own body and vanish in an instant to a spot far ahead.
ability.grandline.fruit.nikyu.where_to_t: Where Would You Like to Travel?
A touch of the paw sends the target flying far over the horizon; it drifts down slowly, far away.
ability.grandline.fruit.nikyu.pain_extra: Pull the pain and fatigue out of your body and your allies' (heal and cure ailments); the pain is kept as a bubble.
ability.grandline.fruit.nikyu.ursus_shoc: Air compressed into a giant paw that detonates like a bomb, adding any extracted pain to the blast.
ability.grandline.fruit.mochi.kaku_mochi: A giant fist of mochi that sticks to whatever it hits.
ability.grandline.fruit.mochi.mochi_tsuk: A piercing thrust of the mochi trident Mogura.
ability.grandline.fruit.mochi.sticky_moc: Mochi engulfs the target: stuck in place and unable to fight back for a moment.
ability.grandline.fruit.mochi.chikara_mo: Giant mochi fists hammer the target area from above.
ability.grandline.fruit.mochi.buzz_cut_m: Spinning mochi donuts on your arms grind through everything on a short charge.
ability.grandline.fruit.mochi.flowing_mo: The ground turns to mochi that swallows enemies' feet, then rises as a crushing wave.
ability.grandline.fruit.horo.negative_ho: A ghost glides through the target: it collapses in despair, unable to fight, and loses its will to chase you.
ability.grandline.fruit.horo.mini_hollow: A flock of little ghosts that burst like firecrackers.
ability.grandline.fruit.horo.toku_hollow: One huge ghost that drifts to the enemy and explodes.
ability.grandline.fruit.horo.spirit_body: Your spirit leaves your body: invisible, weightless and untouchable except by Haki or seastone, but your blows are faint.
ability.grandline.fruit.horo.negative_pa: A swarm of Negative Hollows sweeps the whole area, dropping every enemy into despair.
ability.grandline.fruit.doru.candle_lock: Wax shackles harden around the target's feet.
ability.grandline.fruit.doru.candle_wall: A wall of hardened wax rises in front of you (temporary, never in towns).
ability.grandline.fruit.doru.candle_cham: A suit of wax armour: physical damage taken -40% and your blows hit 40% harder, until fire melts it off.
ability.grandline.fruit.doru.arts_mori.d: A piercing harpoon of steel-hard wax.
ability.grandline.fruit.doru.candle_serv: A giant wax cake slowly coats everyone caught on it until they stand there as wax statues.
"Life or death?" Everyone in front who fears you loses years of lifespan (a share of their health, through guard). Strong wills resist.
ability.grandline.fruit.soru.zeus.desc: The thundercloud Homie strikes the target with lightning three times.
The sun Homie hurls itself as a blazing, exploding fireball.
ability.grandline.fruit.soru.napoleon.de: The bicorne Homie becomes a giant sword; its thrust carves a long line through any guard.
ability.grandline.fruit.soru.living_land: Breathe soul into the land around your enemies: grass, rocks and trees seize and beat them.
Every soul around is asked "life or death?" at once while Zeus and Prometheus rage.
ability.grandline.fruit.hobi.hobby_touch: A single touch turns the target into a toy: shrunk, unable to fight, forgotten by everyone hunting it.
ability.grandline.fruit.hobi.toy_soldier: Tin soldiers march out firing tiny cannons, and every toy bound by your contract turns on your enemy.
ability.grandline.fruit.hobi.toy_box.des: A box of wind-up toys is hurled and bursts, scattering springs and confetti.
Everyone in front below 40% health becomes a toy; the rest are battered by marching toys.
ability.grandline.fruit.hobi.toy_kingdom: Every enemy in a wide area becomes a toy at once, and the world forgets them.
ability.grandline.fruit.toki.time_leap.d: Skip a few seconds into the future: gone, untouchable, then back where you stood. Cannot be used twice in a row in a fight.
ability.grandline.fruit.toki.time_flight: A touch sends the target into the future; it comes back reeling from the jump.
ability.grandline.fruit.toki.skipped_mom: Skip the moment it takes to get there: you are simply behind the target, striking.
ability.grandline.fruit.toki.hourglass.d: Years pass in seconds for everyone in the area: they weaken, slow and wither.
ability.grandline.fruit.toki.twenty_year: Everyone around is flung into the future together and comes back aged.
ability.grandline.fruit.zou_elephant.tra: Cycle Zoan forms: elephant hybrid, full elephant, awakened.
ability.grandline.fruit.zou_elephant.tru: A sweeping lash of the trunk.
A high-pressure jet of water: it reaches Logia bodies and puts out fires on you and your allies.
ability.grandline.fruit.zou_elephant.tus: A thrust of the tusks straight through any guard.
ability.grandline.fruit.zou_elephant.tru: Wrap the trunk around the target, lift it overhead and slam it down behind you.
ability.grandline.fruit.zou_elephant.mam: The awakened beast stamps three times; each quake rolls further out.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_allosaurus.t: Cycle Zoan forms: allosaurus hybrid, full allosaurus, awakened.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_allosaurus.a: Crushing jaws close on the prey; the bite feeds you.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_allosaurus.t: The heavy tail swings all the way round.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_allosaurus.r: Sprint through the enemy line, biting each one in passing.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_allosaurus.a: A roar from a lost age: prey freezes in fear and weakens while your strength rises.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_allosaurus.c: A bite so hard the ground caves in under the prey.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_pteranodon.t: Cycle Zoan forms: pteranodon hybrid, full pteranodon, awakened.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_pteranodon.w: One powerful beat lifts you high into the air (then glide).
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_pteranodon.t: Fold your wings and drop onto the prey, talons first.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_pteranodon.w: The wing edges cut the air into twin crescents.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_pteranodon.g: A beat of both wings blasts everything in front away, projectiles included.
ability.grandline.fruit.ryu_pteranodon.s: Soar high above the battlefield, then crash down in a storm of wing blades.
Cycle Zoan forms: spinosaurus hybrid, full spinosaurus, awakened.
A full turn with the bladed back sail raised; leaves enemies bleeding.
Seize the prey in your jaws and fling it overhead to the ground behind.
The heavy tail comes down like a falling tree and caves in the ground.
Lose yourself to instinct: stronger and faster, every hit 25% harder and healing you.
ability.grandline.fruit.uo_seiryu.transf: Cycle Zoan forms: dragon hybrid, full azure dragon, awakened.
ability.grandline.fruit.uo_seiryu.cloud_: Toggle flight on the clouds while transformed (costs stamina while flying; the sea or seastone grounds you).
ability.grandline.fruit.uo_seiryu.bolo_b: A beam of concentrated heat from the jaws that explodes where it lands.
Cut the air into three great blades of wind.
ability.grandline.fruit.uo_seiryu.dragon: Coil and spin up a tornado that lifts and shreds everything nearby.
ability.grandline.fruit.uo_seiryu.thunde: One colossal, Haki-wreathed blow that splits the ground and calls down thunder.
ability.grandline.fruit.hebi_orochi.tran: Cycle Zoan forms: serpent hybrid, full eight-headed serpent, awakened.
ability.grandline.fruit.hebi_orochi.yama: The heads lunge one after another — four in hybrid form, all eight in full form.
ability.grandline.fruit.hebi_orochi.veno: Fangs sink in deep; the venom keeps working.
ability.grandline.fruit.hebi_orochi.serp: Wrap around the target and squeeze: it is held in place and crushed through its guard.
ability.grandline.fruit.hebi_orochi.regr: Severed heads and torn scales grow back: heal 30% of your health and cure ailments.
ability.grandline.fruit.hebi_orochi.eigh: All eight heads lash out around you at once.
